free_tier.stated: 4 GB per file via URL upload, ~2,800 MB via browser upload. No documented total storage cap per account; Files / Addons / Mods tabs are all upload surfaces on a free account.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 4,000 MB per file (URL upload) / ~2,800 MB (browser upload); uploads cannot be resumed and time out after 12 hours; no total-account cap documented. Retention: indefinite while the page exists; a page can be deleted by staff.

egress.terms: Free public downloads from media.moddb.com; no metered egress documented and no speed cap published.

record.tooling: Web upload form (requires member login); no public write API. Read path is plain HTTP GET on media.moddb.com. 'Click to connect via Steam' means account creation chains off an existing Steam identity.
record.chaining: 4 GB per file x unlimited files x unlimited addon pages x free accounts. Also: URL-upload means the source file can live on another free host, so ModDB acts as a free second copy / re-distribution mirror rather than primary storage.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: 4,000 MB per file (URL upload) / ~2,800 MB (browser upload); uploads cannot be resumed and time out after 12 hours; no total-account cap documented. Retention: indefinite while the page exists; a page can be deleted by staff.
record.reliability_note: Browser-upload path is fragile above ~2.8 GB and there is no resume, so a failed 12-hour upload wastes the slot. media.moddb.com answered 200 with real bytes (238,600) on probe, but the site root returns 503 to datacenter egress. Expect intermittent blocking.

record.notes: 4 GB per file via URL upload, ~2,800 MB via browser upload. No documented total storage cap per account; Files / Addons / Mods tabs are all upload surfaces on a free account.

free_tier.stated: No published total quota, but a large installed base with published aggregate stats: the downloads index reports 149,920 files totalling 43,307.57 GB and 387,395,913 downloads. Mean file size is therefore ~296 MB, and the tail is much larger - a live listing for `objects3` shows '7.86gb (8,442,728,905 bytes)' on a single file. So 8 GB-class single objects are published and served today.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: verified at least 8,442,728,905 bytes on a live file listing; the widely-cited 8192 MB figure is third-party (TWC wiki, marked TBC by its own author) and is contradicted by the 7.86 GB file, so treat ~8 GB as observed-not-documented. retention: indefinite; files stay downloadable for years

egress.terms: Free, no billing, and the site is Cloudflare-fronted (Server: cloudflare on the live origin). Files are served from the site itself rather than a separate CDN hostname; the mirror endpoint (/downloads/mirror/<id>/<n>/<hash>) is the byte path and is behind the same edge.

record.tooling: No upload API and no SFTP: the write path is the web 'Add File' form at /downloads/add, gated to logged-in members. There is a 'URL upload' field (fetch-from-URL) which is the closest thing to automation. Read side is plain anonymous HTTP GET from /downloads/mirror/..., plus an MD5 hash published on each file page.
record.chaining: One account x unlimited game/mod profiles x unlimited files per profile. Because the unit is a mod page, not a repo, cardinality is bounded only by how many plausible mod entries you create. 8.44 GB verified per file x N files.
record.limits_note: Per-object cap is verified at 8,442,728,905 bytes on published files, with approximately 8 GB observed in practice. Retention is indefinite for hosted files. Uploads require web forms and endpoints enforce browser verification headers.
record.reliability_note: Also note the add-file page itself says 'Members only / You do not have permission to add the requested downloads content' when unauthenticated.
